moving-bounds-animation.context: A changing lower bound changes the exact formula, but not necessarily its highest-order term.

steps.title: Foo4: measure one row
steps.body: The integer interval n through n²−1 contains n²−n values.

steps.title: Foo4: repeat n identical rows
steps.body: n rows times n²−n prints per row gives n³−n².

steps.title: Foo4_5: row i loses i points
steps.body: The lower bound moves from 0 to n−1, creating a triangular correction.

steps.title: Subtract the triangular correction
steps.body: Start with n rows of n², then subtract 0+1+...+(n−1).
